review.anatomy: Actual 34-bone app rig inspected in Blender cardinal views and world joint inventory; semantic left is +X for this -Y-facing person. Original names and finger branches stay intact.
review.facing: Actual front face and ear flower visible from Blender -Y; +Y shows back of hair/shirt. No facing rotation or mirroring required.
review.excludedHelper: Icosphere: unweighted, material-free rig display helper, retained in preserved original collection but excluded from body measurements and game export.
review.headPlane: 1.49m is below skull/ear-flower and above the normalized neck; rigid game-copy head region preserves face/hair/flower identity.
review.surfaceRepair: First collapsed game copy showed open triangle cracks across face/neck/cloth. Source-derived 2mm voxel closure is required before final LOD/PBR derivation; original geometry remains untouched.
review.handRepair: Actual app motion and first game copy showed palm/finger branch outliers as skin wedges. Game copy uses an actual wrist-volume forearm/hand blend and rigid relaxed fingers rather than moving the incorrectly inferred finger branches.
review.stride: Actual short leg chains required a 12.9cm crouch at 1.30m travel. Final 0.91m travel per 1.30s cycle matches the heavy person's proportions at 0.70m/s.
review.pending: Repaired derived LOD material/shape, relaxed hand deformation and grounded gait frames are reviewed after finishing, before Unity delivery.
